title: Artifacts
description: References to compiled model artifacts on disk or in object storage. Multiple artifacts may belong to a single run (e.g., a Core ML model and its companion metadata). Joined to runs on run_id.

run_id.description: Foreign key into the runs table identifying the originating benchmark run.

artifact_path.description: File system or object store path to the artifact.

artifact_sha256.description: SHA-256 digest of the artifact file content.

artifact_size_bytes.description: Size of the artifact file in bytes.

compression.description: Compression method applied to the artifact, if any.
